answer: Each epoch every agent must emit a signed heartbeat pulse proving it solved a fresh sequential delay puzzle bound to its identity key; the puzzle takes minutes of real CPU time, so one machine can only pulse once per epoch. A raven-style gossip mesh relays pulses and flags any identity whose pulse arrives twice, while a relic stake — a small deposit locked for the epoch — is slashed when two pulses share one key. Cloning an identity costs a new machine plus a new stake each epoch, so sybils scale in real cost, not in free copies.
